data.name: Pulkit
data.gender_notes: Pulkit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pulkit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pulkita', which means 'Moon, Wisdom'. This name signifies the divine connection between the individual and the cosmic energies of the moon, bestowing upon the bearer a deep sense of intuition and wisdom. The name Pulkit carries the meaning “Moon, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pulkit usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pulkit is a Sanskrit name that is associated with the divine energies of the moon and wisdom. It is believed that the name carries the blessings of the moon god, Chandra, and bestows upon the bearer a deep sense of intuition and spiritual understanding.
data.etymology: Pulkit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pulkit total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
